typology.definition: the hand-registered four-class compositionality typology (the dispatch's classes verbatim); every probe one class + one rationale; committed before any test compute

classes.ATOMIC-FACTOID: the answer is a memorized pair (Topeka->Kansas): one arbitrary association, no derivational or compositional link between subject and answer

adjudication.ledger: THE HUNT'S FINAL LEDGER: the last registered candidate RETIRES WITHOUT NAMING THE DIMENSION. As registered, the typology's separation is ENTIRELY its anchor singleton (R 2.56x/2.63x fires Gmail-only; leave-singleton R' 0.03x/0.03x collapses); the anchor capture is registration, not prediction (zero evidential weight); the class factor is family-collinear except one bit (is_Gmail); no form absorbs the cross-wash residual (best |xwash| 0.924 vs baseline 0.934) — and the residual without Gmail still replicates at 0.930. THE THIRD DIMENSION STANDS AS REAL-AND-UNNAMED in the SILENT bar's sense — adjudicated GRADED because the anchor clause is structurally true; the partial is the anchor's tautology, not evidence for the naming. Real (e219), beyond height (e218), not entrenchment (e219), not tokens (e220), not compositionality-as-typology (e221): the lab's honest open object, the ledger closed with the object intact.

honesty_reflex.hand_registration_at_maximum: THE caveat of this cell: the registrar had read e216/e219/e220's committed tables before assigning classes; the dispatch's own parentheticals name the anchor classes with the residuals known; the registered product rule (FUNCTION iff the answer binds THE cue's maker) was forced by the dispatch's anchor definitions and yields an n=1 class. honesty_reflex.singleton_guard_justification: the guard is not post-hoc bar softening: the n=1 class is a property of the REGISTRATION, visible before any test compute, and the guard is registered with it (docstring + operationalizations, committed with the typology). The precedent is R49/e166: an instrument whose firing is structurally guaranteed by its registration is invalid as confirmation. The unguarded reading is co-reported verbatim so the alternative adjudication is reconstructible
honesty_reflex.typology_is_family_plus_one_bit: as registered, TOKEN-IDENTITY == the lang family and MULTI-HOP == the founder-anchor family (asserted numerically), ATOMIC spans cap-cur + near-uscap + rev-capital + 6/7 products, and FUNCTION-COMPOSED == is_Gmail: the class factor carries EXACTLY one bit beyond family. The absorption test therefore reduces to family + p0 + is_Gmail by construction, and its outcome (no absorption) was structurally foreseeable — reported as such
honesty_reflex.multiple_comparisons: ~10 test readings across 2 washes (R, R', two ordinals, the anchor); the classes are unordered for R (no direction to multiply) but the ordinal pair and the anchor are selected readings — the Bonferroni note applies to any marginal number

honesty_reflex.typology_inherited_family: the family factor is e215's HAND-REGISTERED typology (not blind to the outcome); this cell's compositionality classes are a SECOND hand-registered layer on top — the subjectivity compounds, disclosed
honesty_reflex.ols_conventions: raw bounded hr, plain OLS, homoskedastic SEs never adjudicated; unbalanced class n's (1..38) make the ANOVA convention itself fragile — the KW H co-report carries the rank reading
honesty_reflex.xwash_reading: absorption would mean the class factor carries what p0 carried AND orders the per-probe misses; no form moves it — consistent with the third dimension being orthogonal to every registered surface
honesty_reflex.guarantees_nothing: the typology and its tests describe THESE 54 probes under THESE two washes with TWO stacked hand registrations — the openness is the point
